content.json:
## 💰 Cost Analysis
Cost tracking per department (APIM product subscription) compared against monthly quotas. Prices from PRICING_CL custom table (per 1M tokens).

content.query:
let llmLogs = ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog
| where TimeGenerated >= startofmonth(now()) and TimeGenerated <= endofmonth(now())
| where DeploymentName != '';
let logsWithSub = llmLogs
| join kind=leftouter (
    ApiManagementGatewayLogs
    | where TimeGenerated >= startofmonth(now())
    | summarize ApimSubscriptionId=take_any(ApimSubscriptionId) by CorrelationId
) on CorrelationId
| project SubscriptionName = ApimSubscriptionId, DeploymentName, PromptTokens, CompletionTokens;
logsWithSub
| join kind=inner (
    PRICING_CL
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Model
    | project Model, InputTokensPrice, OutputTokensPrice
) on $left.DeploymentName == $right.Model
| extend InputCost = PromptTokens * InputTokensPrice / 1000000.0
| extend OutputCost = CompletionTokens * OutputTokensPrice / 1000000.0
| summarize TotalCost = round(sum(InputCost + OutputCost), 4) by SubscriptionName
| join kind=inner (
    SUBSCRIPTION_QUOTA_CL
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Subscription
    | project Subscription, CostQuota
) on $left.SubscriptionName == $right.Subscription
| project Department = replace_string(SubscriptionName, 'subscription-', ''), CostQuota, TotalCost
content.title: Cost by Department vs Quota (Current Month)

content.query:
let llmLogs = ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog
| where TimeGenerated >= startofmonth(now()) and TimeGenerated <= endofmonth(now())
| where DeploymentName != '';
let logsWithSub = llmLogs
| join kind=leftouter (
    ApiManagementGatewayLogs
    | where TimeGenerated >= startofmonth(now())
    | summarize ApimSubscriptionId=take_any(ApimSubscriptionId) by CorrelationId
) on CorrelationId
| project SubscriptionName = ApimSubscriptionId, DeploymentName, PromptTokens, CompletionTokens;
logsWithSub
| join kind=inner (
    PRICING_CL
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Model
    | project Model, InputTokensPrice, OutputTokensPrice
) on $left.DeploymentName == $right.Model
| extend Cost = (PromptTokens * InputTokensPrice + CompletionTokens * OutputTokensPrice) / 1000000.0
| summarize TotalCost = round(sum(Cost), 4) by SubscriptionName
| join kind=inner (
    SUBSCRIPTION_QUOTA_CL
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Subscription
    | project Subscription, CostQuota
) on $left.SubscriptionName == $right.Subscription
| extend UsagePercent = round(TotalCost / CostQuota * 100, 1)
| project Department = replace_string(SubscriptionName, 'subscription-', ''), UsagePercent
| order by UsagePercent desc
content.title: Quota Usage % (Current Month)

content.query:
let llmLogs = ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog
| where DeploymentName != '';
let logsWithSub = llmLogs
| join kind=leftouter (
    ApiManagementGatewayLogs
    | summarize ApimSubscriptionId=take_any(ApimSubscriptionId) by CorrelationId
) on CorrelationId
| project TimeGenerated, SubscriptionName = ApimSubscriptionId, DeploymentName, PromptTokens, CompletionTokens;
logsWithSub
| join kind=inner (
    PRICING_CL
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Model
    | project Model, InputTokensPrice, OutputTokensPrice
) on $left.DeploymentName == $right.Model
| extend Cost = (PromptTokens * InputTokensPrice + CompletionTokens * OutputTokensPrice) / 1000000.0
| summarize TotalCost = round(sum(Cost), 4) by Department = replace_string(SubscriptionName, 'subscription-', ''), bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Cost Over Time by Department

content.json:
## 📊 Usage Analysis
Token consumption and request volume broken down by model and department.

content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog
| where DeploymentName != ''
| summarize Requests = count(), TotalTokens = sum(TotalTokens) by Model = DeploymentName
| order by Requests desc
content.title: Requests & Tokens by Model

content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog
| where DeploymentName != ''
| join kind=leftouter (
    ApiManagementGatewayLogs
    | summarize ApimSubscriptionId=take_any(ApimSubscriptionId) by CorrelationId
) on CorrelationId
| summarize PromptTokens = sum(PromptTokens), CompletionTokens = sum(CompletionTokens)
    by Department = replace_string(ApimSubscriptionId, 'subscription-', '')
| order by PromptTokens desc
content.title: Token Usage by Department

content.json:
## 🏗️ Infrastructure
Backend routing distribution and API response status codes.

content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where BackendId != ''
| summarize Requests = count() by Backend = BackendId
| order by Requests desc
content.title: Backend Distribution

content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| summarize Requests = count() by StatusCode = tostring(ResponseCode)
| order by StatusCode asc
content.title: Response Status Codes
